text: “There’s a barrel of it over there,” said Miss Harris, shaking her bangles at it. “It’s the only kind we have.” “I’ll--I’ll take twenty pounds of it,” said Matthew, with beads of perspiration standing on his forehead. Matthew had driven halfway home before he was his own man again. It had been a gruesome experience, but it served him right, he thought, for committing the heresy of going to a strange store. When he reached home he hid the rake in the tool house, but the sugar he carried in to Marilla.
